description: Accessibility policy contract — validates WCAG standard, CI enforcement, exclusion limits, manual checkpoints, and disabled rule justifications

rules.description: wcagVersion must be 2.1 or 2.2 — 2.0 is outdated
wcagLevel must be AA or AAA — Level A alone is insufficient
spec.exclude must have ≤ 10 selectors; no broad selectors like 'body', 'main', 'div'
At least 3 manual testing checkpoints must be defined
Every disabled rule must have a documented reason (object with ruleId + reason)
